newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list Legg Mason, Whittmann-Hart options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list Legg Mason, Whittmann-Hart options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Friday it would list options on Legg Mason Inc and Whittman-Hart Inc on May 1.
The exchange said Legg Mason options would open with strike prices of 40, 45 and 50, with position limits of 4,500 contracts. Initial expirations have been set for May, June, August and November.
Cohen, Duffy & McGowan Inc has been named the specialist unit for the options, the AMEX said.
Whittmann-Hart options would have opening strike prices of 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2. Position limits of 4,500 contracts have been set.
The options would have initial expirations in May, June, August and November.
The AMEX said Gargoyle Specialist LP has been named the specialist unit for Whittmann-Hart options.
